nova.power-invite.speaker: nova
nova.power-invite.text: Gia, the aquarium needs two superheroes. Will you and Penguin choose bubble power?

nova.power-first.speaker: nova
nova.power-first.text: Bubble power activated! You and Penguin are making the aquarium shimmer.

nova.power-repeat.speaker: nova
nova.power-repeat.text: More moon bubbles! Pop, pop, pop!

luma.hello.speaker: luma
luma.hello.text: Oh! Bubble power tickles! I'm Luma. Gia and Penguin, tap my moon bells and make a song with me!

luma.ocho-clue.speaker: luma
luma.ocho-clue.text: You beauty! Our bells woke three moon pearls. Follow their glow to Ocho!

ocho.hello.speaker: ocho
ocho.hello.text: Hey, Gia and Penguin! I'm Ocho. Tap each moon pearl and I'll conduct the aquarium song!

ocho.pearl-first.speaker: ocho
ocho.pearl-first.text: Beautiful moon pearl! It found its note.

ocho.pearl-repeat.speaker: ocho
ocho.pearl-repeat.text: Again? Absolutely! Watch all eight arms!

ocho.finale.speaker: ocho
ocho.finale.text: Gia and Penguin, that's our moonlight song! The whole aquarium is glowing!

narrator.story-opening.speaker: narrator
narrator.story-opening.text: Gia and Penguin's Bubble-Power Adventure. One moonlit night, Gia arrived at the aquarium with Penguin tucked safely under her arm. They heard a tiny splash at the door. Nova Kitty needed two superheroes. Gia chose bubble power. Penguin held on tight as a bright blue bubble spun around them, and the sleepy aquarium began to shimmer.

narrator.story-one-bubble.speaker: narrator
narrator.story-one-bubble.text: Gia and Penguin watched one enormous moon bubble float all the way to the twinkling water.

narrator.story-many-bubbles.speaker: narrator
narrator.story-many-bubbles.text: Gia used her bubble power again and again while Penguin bobbed happily beside her. Enormous moon bubbles danced toward the twinkling water.

narrator.story-bells.speaker: narrator
narrator.story-bells.text: Then Gia and Penguin met Luma the moon jellyfish and made his bells glow with a sparkly song.

narrator.story-ocho.speaker: narrator
narrator.story-ocho.text: The glowing bells led Gia and Penguin to Ocho, an octopus with eight arms and a moon-pearl baton.

narrator.story-pearl-blue.speaker: narrator
narrator.story-pearl-blue.text: Gia placed the blue circle moon pearl while Penguin kept the beat.

narrator.story-pearl-gold.speaker: narrator
narrator.story-pearl-gold.text: Gia placed the gold star moon pearl while Penguin kept the beat.

narrator.story-pearl-coral.speaker: narrator
narrator.story-pearl-coral.text: Gia placed the coral diamond moon pearl while Penguin kept the beat.

narrator.story-pearl-repeats.speaker: narrator
narrator.story-pearl-repeats.text: Gia played the moon pearls again, and Ocho conducted with more and more arms while Penguin danced faster.

narrator.story-finale.speaker: narrator
narrator.story-finale.text: Ocho lifted his baton. Luma shimmered, Nova Kitty purred, and Penguin stood proudly beside Gia as the whole aquarium played Gia's moonlight song.

narrator.story-ending.speaker: narrator
narrator.story-ending.text: Nova Kitty purred. The animals knew you and Penguin would find a wonderfully bubbly way to help.
